在众人的羡慕中，大家一起去了食堂，现在第三食堂已经成了王野他们办公室的必去食堂。在这里饭菜好吃，主要是还没人敢颠勺，那必须得来这里呀！在王野等人到了打饭口时，何雨柱看见众人，赶紧招呼王野：“兄弟，你来下后厨。”

王野见何雨柱叫他去后厨，便跟着进去了，这里王野来的次数多了。王野学厨的时候，就跟第三食堂后厨的人很熟悉了。

“兄弟，我爹让我跟你说，今天他就去找易中海，他让你不论发生什么事儿都不要去我们院儿。”

“柱子哥，我还是......”

“兄弟放心吧！我爹说他全都准备好了，不会出意外的。再说了哥哥也不是软柿子，你以为哥哥的战神称号是白来的呀！”

“行吧，我就在家等着，要是有什么意外，你就让雨水来叫我。”

“好嘞，谢了兄弟！”

王野吃完饭就回了办公室，看着手里的的自行车票，越看越心痒痒。不行，不能等了，这就去买了，科长是自己师父，出去翘个班都不行，那还要什么师父呀。王野邪恶的想着，去了吴志强的办公室。

一推门就进去了：“吴叔，我下午出去一趟。”

“你出去干嘛？”

“买自行车呀！”王野理直气壮的说。

“你个狗窝里放不住粮的玩意儿，刚到手就要去买呀？”

“师父，你是饱汉子不知饿汉子饥。要不我不去买了，你把你的自行车给我骑。”

“你给我滚蛋，你上回骑了一下，我擦了半宿，你个小兔崽子是一点也不知道爱惜。手里的钱够不，要不我给你点儿？”

“吴叔，你那钱还是留着吧！这点儿小钱儿我还是有的。”

“滚滚滚！听你说话我就来气。”

王野回到办公室拿起自己的包就出了工厂。一路蹦蹦跳跳的来到了百货大楼，进了大楼，王野直接去了卖自行车的地方。交钱给票推车出门，一切顺利也没有什么大打出手的场面。

骑着新车，拿着单据，直奔派出所，到了派出所，王野直奔李伟办公室。敲门进屋，李伟看见是王野好奇的说：“小野？你怎么来了，这是有事儿？”

“李叔，我买了一辆自行车，这不是需要登记嘛，这不就找你来了。”

“你买的黑车？”

“不是啊！百货大楼买的。”

“票来历不好？”

“单位发的，没有不好吧。”

“那你直接去车管所登记就行了呗！找我干嘛？”

“李叔，我不是不知道车管所在哪儿吗！”

“你个臭小子找我问路呀？大街上随便问一个人不就行了。”

“嘿嘿，李叔我以为上牌挺麻烦的，这不才来找你呀！”

“麻烦个屁！都是合理合法来的，能有什么麻烦。滚蛋！出门往东一里地就到了。”

“好嘞，谢谢李叔！”

Amid everyone's envy, everyone went to the canteen together. Now the third canteen has become the must-go canteen in Wang Ye's office.The food here is delicious, mainly because no one dares to take a spoon, so you must come here!When Wang Ye and others arrived at the food outlet, He Yuzhu saw everyone and quickly called to Wang Ye: "Brother, come and cook."

When Wang Ye saw He Yuzhu asking him to go to the kitchen, he followed him in. Wang Ye came here many times.When Wang Ye was learning how to cook, he became very familiar with the people behind the kitchen in the Third Canteen.

"Brother, my father asked me to tell you that he is going to see Yi Zhonghai today. He asked you not to go to our courtyard no matter what happens."

"Brother Zhuzi, I still..."

"Don't worry, brother! My father said that he has prepared everything and nothing will happen. Besides, my brother is not a soft persimmon. Do you think that my brother's title of God of War is for nothing?"

"Okay, I'll wait at home. If anything happens, just ask Yu Yu to call me."

"Okay, thanks brother!"

Wang Ye returned to the office after eating. He looked at the bicycle ticket in his hand, and the more he looked at it, the more he felt itchy.No, I can't wait any longer, so I went to buy it now. The section chief is my master. If I can't even skip a class, then what kind of master do I need?Wang Ye thought evilly and went to Wu Zhiqiang's office.

He opened the door and went in: "Uncle Wu, I'm going out in the afternoon."

"What are you going out for?"

"Buy a bicycle!" Wang Ye said confidently.

"You can't keep food in the kennel, why are you going to buy it as soon as you get it?"

"Master, you are a full man and don't know how hungry a man is. Why don't I go buy it and give me your bicycle to ride?"

"Get out of here. You rode me a little bit last time and I wiped you for half a night. You little brat don't know how to cherish me at all. Do you have enough money in your hand? How about I give you some?"

"Uncle Wu, you should keep your money! I still have this little money."

"Go away! I'm going to get angry just listening to you."

Wang Ye returned to the office, picked up his bag and left the factory.After jumping all the way to the department store, Wang Ye went directly to the place where bicycles were sold.After paying for the ticket and pushing the cart out, everything went smoothly and there was no big fight.

Riding a new car, holding the receipt, he went straight to the police station. When he arrived at the police station, Wang Ye went straight to Li Wei's office.After knocking on the door and entering the house, Li Wei saw Wang Ye and said curiously: "Xiaoye? Why are you here? Is there something wrong?"

"Uncle Li, I bought a bicycle. Doesn't it need to be registered? I'm here to find you."

"Did you buy a black car?"

"No! I bought it from a department store."

"Is the ticket from a bad source?"

"The unit issued it, so there's nothing wrong with it."

"Then just go to the vehicle management office to register! What are you looking for for me?"

"Uncle Li, don't I know where the DMV is?"

"You brat, you want to ask me for directions? Just ask anyone on the street."

"Hey, Uncle Li, I thought it would be troublesome to get a card, so I just came to see you!"

"It's so troublesome! We're all here legitimately, so why bother? Get out of here! We'll be there just a mile east."

"Okay, thank you Uncle Li!"
